startups.about: AI SOC Agents & Agentic Security Platform
startups.description: 7AI deploys autonomous AI agent swarms for security operations centers, automating alert enrichment, threat investigation, incident response, and threat hunting at Fortune 500 scale. Named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies 2026, ranked #6 in Security.

startups.about: Precision AI Search for Legal Teams
startups.description: DeepJudge provides enterprise search and AI-powered workflows that transform firm-wide knowledge and data into a competitive advantage for legal teams. Their LLM-agnostic agentic reasoning executes complex multi-step research tasks across internal and external data sources.

startups.about: Universal API for AI Agent Integration
startups.description: StackOne provides a universal API layer that enables AI agents to securely connect with enterprise SaaS tools and internal systems. It acts as the middleware infrastructure allowing agentic AI to interact with any software tool through a single integration point.

Adaptive Security uses AI to create dynamic, personalized security awareness training programs that adapt to each employee's risk profile and learning patterns. Valued at approximately $9 billion after its latest funding round backed by OpenAI, NVIDIA, and Bain Capital Ventures.

Doppel uses AI to detect and take down brand impersonation, phishing, and digital fraud across the internet in real time. The platform monitors domains, social media, marketplaces, and app stores to protect enterprises from threat actors mimicking their brand.

startups.about: The Data Engine for AI Model Development
startups.description: Encord provides an end-to-end data engine for AI teams to manage, annotate, and evaluate training data at scale. The platform supports computer vision, medical imaging, and NLP workflows, enabling teams to ship production-ready models faster with higher quality data.

startups.about: AI-Powered Project Management for Software Teams
startups.description: Blossom is an AI-native project management platform designed specifically for software development teams. It leverages AI to predict project risks, automate sprint planning, and provide intelligent insights into team productivity and delivery timelines.

Omnea is an AI-powered procurement platform that automates vendor management, contract reviews, and spend optimization for enterprises. It uses machine learning to identify cost-saving opportunities and streamline the entire procurement lifecycle.

startups.about: AI Voice Agents for Healthcare Practices
startups.description: Avoca builds autonomous AI voice agents that fully handle front desk calls, patient intake, scheduling, and insurance verification for healthcare practices. Their agents don't just assist staff — they replace routine call handling entirely, reducing no-show rates and improving patient access.

Harmonic is an AI-powered business intelligence platform that automatically discovers, analyzes, and visualizes insights from enterprise data without requiring SQL or technical expertise. It uses natural language queries to generate real-time dashboards and reports.

OpenAI is the leading AI research and deployment company behind GPT-4o, DALL-E, Sora, and the ChatGPT platform. With an estimated annualized revenue of $25 billion and $852 billion valuation, it remains the most well-funded AI startup in history.

Anthropic builds the Claude family of Large Language Models with a focus on safe and scalable AI systems. The company has raised over $18.2B in funding and continues to advance constitutional AI methods for building more reliable and steerable AI assistants.

xAI is Elon Musk's AI company building the Grok series of large language models and the Colossus supercomputer. The company closed a landmark $20 billion Series E in January 2026 and is valued at over $200 billion, making it one of the most valuable AI startups globally.

Perplexity AI is an AI-powered answer engine that provides direct, cited answers to questions using real-time web search and LLMs. With over $1.5B in total funding, it has become the go-to research tool for millions of users seeking accurate and sourced information.

Mistral AI is a French AI company developing open-weight and commercial large language models that rival proprietary systems. The company raised 2 billion euros at a 13.8 billion euro valuation and has become Europe's leading AI startup, challenging US dominance in foundation models.

Cohere provides enterprise-grade LLMs and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions for businesses. The company raised $600M at a $7B valuation and focuses on helping organizations deploy secure, private AI models within their own infrastructure.

Anduril creates advanced defense technology by pairing AI software with autonomous hardware systems including drones, surveillance towers, and underwater vehicles. The company raised another $5B in May 2026 as defense tech startups shatter funding records globally.

Figure is an AI robotics company building the world's first commercially viable autonomous humanoid robot. Based in Sunnyvale, CA, the company is part of a humanoid robotics wave projected to draw $20B+ in funding through 2026 as manufacturing and logistics demand grows.

Skild AI builds foundation models specifically designed for robotics applications, enabling robots to learn and generalize across different tasks and environments. The company is part of the humanoid robotics sector projected to draw $20B+ in funding through 2026.

Anysphere is the company behind Cursor, one of the most popular AI-powered code editors that enables developers to write, refactor, and debug code using natural language. It has quickly become a breakout product company in the AI development tools space.

Replit is an AI-powered browser-based IDE that enables anyone to build software using natural language prompts. The platform supports 50+ programming languages and includes AI agents that can generate, debug, and deploy full applications from plain English descriptions.

Beacon Health builds AI agents that handle primary care workflows including patient triage, appointment scheduling, and follow-up coordination. Founded by Obinna A. and Mark Pothen, the startup aims to make healthcare more accessible through intelligent automation.

Eos AI uses satellite imagery and machine learning to provide real-time earth observation analytics for agriculture, climate monitoring, and disaster response. The platform processes petabytes of satellite data to deliver actionable intelligence for governments and enterprises.

startups.about: Payments Infrastructure for Voice AI Agents
startups.description: Maven provides the payments infrastructure that enables voice AI agents to securely process transactions, handle billing, and manage payment workflows autonomously. Founded by Wasi Ahmed and Brandon Boehme, it bridges the gap between AI agents and financial transactions.

Seeing Systems builds AI-powered drone systems for autonomous infrastructure inspection and surveillance. Their technology enables drones to navigate, inspect, and report on bridges, power lines, and industrial facilities without human piloting, reducing inspection costs by up to 80%.

Listen Labs uses AI to automate user research by conducting, analyzing, and synthesizing customer interviews at scale. The platform replaces manual research workflows with AI-driven insights, helping product teams make data-informed decisions faster than traditional methods.

startups.about: AI Data Infrastructure & Training Data Platform
startups.description: Scale AI provides the data infrastructure for AI, including data labeling, RLHF, and evaluation services that power the world's most advanced AI models. The company serves major AI labs and enterprises building production AI systems across automotive, government, and technology sectors.

Aurora develops autonomous driving technology specifically for long-haul trucking. Their Aurora Driver platform enables Class 8 trucks to navigate highways autonomously, and they are among the top edge AI startups by total funding raised in the autonomous vehicle sector.

Romantic AI is a trending AI companion platform that provides personalized AI-driven conversational experiences. Ranked as one of the top trending startups in May 2026 by Exploding Topics, it represents the growing consumer AI companion market.

Wise AI provides AI-driven financial advisory and wealth management tools for retail investors. The platform uses machine learning to analyze market trends, portfolio risk, and investment opportunities, delivering personalized financial recommendations at scale.

LMArena provides a comprehensive benchmarking and evaluation platform for large language models, enabling developers and enterprises to compare, test, and validate AI model performance. The company secured a landmark funding round as part of the Q1 2026 AI funding surge.

startups.about: Autonomous AI Marketing Agent for Startups
startups.description: NoimosAI is the premier autonomous marketing agent for growth-focused startups, acting as a 24/7 autonomous marketing department. The AI agent handles content creation, campaign management, SEO optimization, and performance analytics without human oversight.

Starship Technologies develops small self-driving robotic delivery vehicles that operate on sidewalks and pedestrian areas. The Estonian company, headquartered in San Francisco, has become a leader in last-mile autonomous delivery, completing millions of deliveries globally.

Coconote is an AI-powered study platform developed under the Quizlet umbrella that generates quizzes, flashcards, and study materials from any content using large language models. It represents the evolution of AI in education and personalized learning.

SorceJobs uses AI agents to automate the entire recruitment pipeline from candidate sourcing and screening to interview scheduling and offer management. The platform helps companies hire faster by replacing manual recruiting workflows with intelligent automation.

startups.about: AI Agent for Mobile App Development & Testing
startups.description: Rork provides AI agents that automate mobile application development and testing workflows. Part of the Limrun platform ecosystem, it enables developers to build and test mobile experiences using natural language instructions and AI-driven quality assurance.

Momentic is an AI testing agent that automates end-to-end software testing by understanding application behavior and generating test cases intelligently. The platform reduces testing time by up to 90% by using LLMs to interpret UI elements and create robust test automations.

startups.about: AI Agent for Mobile UX Optimization
startups.description: Minitap uses AI agents to analyze and optimize mobile user experiences by tracking user interactions, identifying friction points, and automatically suggesting UX improvements. The platform provides real-time insights that help product teams improve app engagement and retention.

Apilayer provides a suite of API infrastructure services that enable developers to integrate financial data, geolocation, weather, and other data services into their applications. The platform serves thousands of developers worldwide with reliable and scalable API endpoints.

Atmos Financial is a climate-focused FinTech platform that provides banking and financial services specifically designed for environmentally conscious consumers and businesses. The platform routes deposits to climate-positive projects and offers green financial products.

Ev Structure provides an AI-powered platform for managing and optimizing electric vehicle charging infrastructure. The platform uses machine learning to predict demand, optimize energy distribution, and manage charging station networks for fleet operators and property managers.

Flex uses AI to optimize workforce scheduling and management for industries with shift-based work. The platform uses machine learning to predict staffing needs, minimize labor costs, and ensure compliance while giving workers flexibility in their schedules.

Stripe is a leading payments infrastructure company that has increasingly integrated AI into its platform for fraud detection, revenue optimization, and automated financial operations. While not a startup in the traditional sense, it continues to lead FinTech innovation globally.

Glean provides AI-powered enterprise search that connects to all of a company's data sources and uses LLMs to deliver instant, accurate answers. The platform understands context and relationships across documents, chats, tickets, and wikis, making organizational knowledge instantly accessible.

Abridge uses AI to automatically generate clinical documentation from patient-provider conversations. The platform listens to medical visits, extracts relevant clinical information, and creates structured notes that integrate with electronic health record systems, saving physicians hours of documentation time.

startups.about: AI Code Generation & Software Development Platform
startups.description: Poolside is building advanced AI models specifically for software code generation. The company focuses on creating AI that can understand, plan, and implement complex software systems, making programming more accessible and dramatically increasing developer productivity.

startups.about: Devin — The First AI Software Engineer
startups.description: Cognition is the company behind Devin, the world's first fully autonomous AI software engineer that can plan, execute, and debug complex coding tasks end-to-end. Devin represents a breakthrough in agentic AI for software development, autonomously building and deploying applications.

Sierra AI builds conversational AI agents that handle complex customer service interactions for enterprise companies. Unlike simple chatbots, Sierra's agents can take actions, resolve issues, and adapt their communication style to match each brand's voice and policies.

Cleanlab provides an automated data curation platform that uses AI to find and fix data quality issues in any dataset. The platform automatically detects mislabeled data, outliers, and inconsistencies, helping ML teams improve model accuracy by improving their training data quality.

Weights & Biases provides the leading platform for ML experiment tracking, dataset versioning, and model management. Used by thousands of ML teams worldwide, W&B helps track experiments, visualize results, and manage the entire ML lifecycle from research to production.

Cursor is an AI-native code editor built by Anysphere that enables developers to write, refactor, and debug code using natural language. It has become one of the most popular AI development tools with millions of developers using it to dramatically increase coding productivity.

Vercel is the frontend cloud platform that enables developers to build, deploy, and scale web applications and AI-powered experiences. The platform supports Next.js and other frameworks and has become the go-to infrastructure for shipping AI web applications rapidly.

Runway provides generative AI tools for creative professionals including video generation, image editing, and multimedia content creation. Their Gen-3 Alpha model enables text-to-video generation, and their platform has become essential for filmmakers, designers, and content creators.

Hugging Face is the leading open-source AI platform, hosting over 1 million models, datasets, and ML applications. The platform enables developers to discover, share, and deploy AI models and has become the central hub for the global open-source AI community.

Lemonade uses AI and behavioral economics to provide renters, homeowners, pet, and life insurance with instant claims processing. Their AI chatbot Maya can provide a quote in seconds and process claims in minutes, making insurance faster and more transparent than traditional providers.

K Health provides AI-driven primary care by offering a symptom checker that compares user symptoms to millions of real medical records. The platform provides personalized health assessments and connects patients with licensed doctors for treatment, reducing unnecessary emergency visits.

Viz.ai uses AI to analyze medical images in real-time and automatically alert care teams to critical conditions like strokes and pulmonary embolisms. Their FDA-cleared algorithms reduce diagnosis-to-treatment time by automatically detecting findings and triggering care coordination workflows.

Duolingo uses AI to personalize language learning experiences for over 500 million users worldwide. Their AI tutor adapts lessons to each learner's pace and style, and the company has increasingly integrated generative AI for creating content and providing conversational practice.

Sana Labs uses AI to create personalized corporate learning experiences that adapt to each employee's knowledge and learning style. The platform generates interactive courses from existing content and uses spaced repetition and retrieval practice to maximize knowledge retention.

Wiz provides a cloud security platform that uses AI to detect and prioritize security risks across cloud infrastructure. The company has grown rapidly to become one of the most valuable cybersecurity startups, providing agentless scanning and risk prioritization for multi-cloud environments.
startups.headquarters: Tel Aviv, Israel / New York, USA
